title: Before selling anything: loads, tax, hybrids, records
objectives: Check exit loads per instalment and capital-gains tax before any redemption.
Say why hybrid-fund holders need no rebalance, and what to record.
body_md:
Before selling anything. Exit loads: each SIP instalment has its own date; recent units may still carry a load. Tax: each redemption may create capital gains, and short-term gains are usually taxed more heavily. Refer the client to a CA. Hybrid funds: where a client holds a multi-asset or balanced advantage fund, rebalancing happens inside the fund and the client does not redeem. Record it: what was moved, why, and the client's approval.

> **Investor takeaway:** Each SIP instalment has its own exit-load date.
example: Rebalance would redeem units bought 6 months ago: check exit load and short-term gains; use new money or wait where sensible; refer tax to a CA.
say: Each switch is a redemption that may carry load and tax.
